text:
jamie_sales: Quick heads-up-- Aurora POC demo in 45m. Two open risks: customer asked for (1) guaranteed demo capacity and (2) completed security questionnaire items on PCI scoping. They also saw intermittent 429s during smoke tests.

oliver_se: Which tenant and sample req? Any headers?

jamie_sales: tenant=aurora-poc, sample=req_ap_7a. Header: X-RateLimit-Remaining:0 Retry-After:3. They ran ~30 parallel browser tabs during warmup.

mina_engineer: Short term: we can grant a 20m burst_override and suggest lowering parallelism. Long term: recommend reserved QPS or Dedicated. Ops, can you apply a temporary burst?

ops_oncall: I can. Will run `POST /internal/admin/tenants/aurora-poc/burst {"minutes":20,"qps":350}` if SE approves. Also note cluster delta=2 free nodes.

oliver_se: Approve. Also prepare a minimal client backoff snippet to send to the customer (max concurrency=8, expo backoff with jitter). I'll paste after this message.

ci_bot: [autoscaler] cluster-delta free_nodes=2 last_deploy=stable@2026-11-25T11:20Z

tara_security: For PCI items: please open a separate thread with the exact flow (are card numbers sent to Redwood or tokenized client-side?). We need that to answer questionnaire Q4-Q7. I'll standby for docs.

jamie_sales: They tokenized cards client-side and send token to our API. I'll start the security thread now and attach their questionnaire PDF.

ops_oncall: Burst applied for 20m. Ticket OPS-1234. Watching ingress for req_ap_7a.

mina_engineer: Logs show initial 429 then success after burst:
```
[INGRESS] 2026-11-25T11:34:02Z tenant=aurora-poc req=req_ap_7a status=429 reason=bucket_empty concurrent=32
[INGRESS] 2026-11-25T11:34:03Z tenant=aurora-poc req=req_ap_7a status=200 lat_ms=120
```
jamie_sales: Demo went well, customer asked for pricing for 1k sustained QPS and a Dedicated trial. I'll schedule follow-up with pricing + security. Thanks team! :tada:
